verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that an admin can enable or disable Copilot agents per organization, group, or instance, nor set allow/ask/deny policies for agent tools. The account-level Copilot settings page (github-docs-53) covers individual user settings, not group or instance governance. The 'Ask' vs 'Agent' chat-mode dropdown and fine-grained PAT permissions are adjacent features, not agent tool-policy controls.
